library.pt_240:r_e6a09058a5eb3fd3.text:
An android built by Timothy Waynewright to look exactly like his daughter. However, she weighs 130 kilograms.
The 'R' stands for 'Robot.'
Having no reward to offer for the case surrounding the Waynewright inheritance, she chose instead to work as a maid at $$ロジャー$$'s mansion.
She is not only an android of remarkable completeness, but was made to be an extremely human-like presence - showing Waynewright a rich range of expressions, pouring affection on cats, and asking $$ロジャー$$ questions about love. Because of this, there were times when $$ロジャー$$ forgot she was an android.
Her curt, brazen attitude sometimes leaves $$ロジャー$$ at a loss for words, but as time passed, she became something like a good partner to him.
The headband-like part on her head is a memory drive, and it has often doubled as a light source.
She takes piano playing as a hobby, though her repertoire at first consisted solely of pieces with a violent tone. But under the guidance of the pianist android R. Instro, she gradually broadened the range of what she played.

library.pt_240:r_bd0f04425e3bf002.text:
A butler serving $$ロジャー$$. Age 54.
Long before $$ロジャー$$ came to visit the decrepit bank that would later become his mansion, he had been waiting for his master to appear, following the memories of $$ビッグオー$$'s maintenance.
He displays a wide range of abilities in his daily life without difficulty, from maintaining $$ビッグオー$$ to servicing $$ロジャー$$'s beloved car the Griffon and handling all the household chores of the mansion. Given how much he accomplishes, it would not be an exaggeration to say that $$ロジャー$$'s life is held together thanks to him.
He possesses a will of iron that is shaken by nothing; even when $$ロジャー$$ was kidnapped, he worried but dealt with it calmly without losing his composure. He also showed a powerful side, riding a large motorcycle with a sidecar across the battlefield and handling heavy weapons when enemies attacked.

library.pt_240:r_6a9077ecde1547df.text:
Chief of the Paradigm military police and commander of its mobile unit. Age 47.
A gruff man who takes pride in his work as military police and faithfully carries out his duties. Regardless of whether it is inside or outside the Dome, he also possesses a strong sense of justice, willing to defy orders from above and act on his own judgment to protect the citizens. Many subordinates admire him and act alongside him.
Though he sometimes butts heads with $$ロジャー$$, a former subordinate of his, deep down the two trust each other and have built a good friendship.
During the Megadeus incidents, he grew frustrated with his own powerlessness and that of the military police, and began to doubt the very value of the military police's existence. But once $$ロジャー$$ turned out to be $$ビッグオー$$'s pilot, he willingly took it upon himself to support him.
In the final episode, he shows the resolve to throw away his badge - the very symbol of his pride as military police - without hesitation, in order to save $$ビッグオー$$ from a crisis.

library.pt_240:r_9ae885dc961c01b8.text:
A mysterious woman whose nationality, age, and nearly everything else about her are shrouded in mystery.
She calls herself Angel, perhaps because of a scar on her back that looks as though wings once grew there.
Her motive is unclear, but she seems to be after obtaining memories, and she turns up before $$ロジャー$$ time and again.
She has a bold personality that is intimidated by no one, along with the drive to go wherever her memories lead her, even to the dangerous depths of the sea.
She is affiliated with Paradigm Corporation, but her actions are not motivated by the company's interests - only by her own desire for her memories.

library.pt_240:r_8d9534652f063e83.text:
First-generation head of the Paradigm Group.
He has now left the company in the hands of his son Alex and devotes himself to growing artificial tomatoes on a farm outside the city. Even so, his enormous influence remains very much alive.
He is a man who may know the truth behind the Memories, and when $$ロジャー$$ came to visit him, he spoke words hinting that something had once happened between the two of them.
In his unfinished autobiography '$$メトロポリス$$,' he records events believed to have occurred 40 years ago.

library.pt_240:r_f8b2f1b5be01e663.text:
First-generation head of the Paradigm Group.
He has now left the company in the hands of his son Alex and devotes himself to growing artificial tomatoes on a farm outside the city. Even so, his enormous influence remains very much alive.
He is a man who may know the truth behind the Memories, and when $$ロジャー$$ came to visit him, he spoke words hinting that something had once happened between the two of them. Also, a photograph from his younger days shows him shaking hands with a man who is the spitting image of $$ロジャー$$, suggesting some connection between the two of them.
In his unfinished autobiography '$$メトロポリス$$,' he records events believed to have occurred 40 years ago.
After seeing Angel off in a mysterious space deep within Paradigm City, he vanished, wishing for the true author of $$メトロポリス$$ to record the Memories.

library.pt_240:r_4b87c8979524292a.text:
A memory digger who searches for the truth behind memories lost more than 40 years ago.
He was once a newspaper reporter for Paradigm Press named $$マイケル$$ Seebach, but having become obsessed with pursuing the truth, he discovered a Megadeus archetype at the bottom of an underground passage. However, removing its lock left him transformed into an eerie figure wrapped head to toe in bandages.
Incidentally, $$シュバルツバルト$$ is German for 'black forest.'
He later discovered $$ビッグデュオ$$ and challenged $$ロジャー$$ to a duel, but was defeated. Astonished to see $$ビッグデュオ$$ act on its own at that moment, he vanished from the public eye.
He has a habit of speaking as though reciting poetry, weaving in cryptic, meaningful words, and he looks down on those who do not seek the truth and simply live for the moment.

library.pt_240:r_891cf066ad18ec0e.text:
A criminal who commits crime after crime in Paradigm City. Age 22.
He appears with a vulgar laugh and dirties his hands with every kind of crime - bank robbery, kidnapping, fraud. His words and conduct are those of a common thug through and through; in $$ロジャー$$'s words, 'a criminal with no qualifications to call himself a pro.'
He holds memories of an interface substitute technology vital to piloting a Megadeus, so he procures Megadeuses and uses them for crime.
After $$ロジャー$$ sends him to prison over the kidnapping of the Soldano heiress, he calls $$ロジャー$$ 'that crow bastard' and swears revenge. He then repeatedly breaks out of prison, scheming again and again to bring $$ロジャー$$ to his end.

He later receives a death sentence, but is coerced into cooperating with Paradigm Corporation in exchange for having the sentence overturned, and reluctantly lends a hand.
Puzzled that $$ドロシー#240$$ keeps moving even after her memory unit is taken from her, he ultimately gives her advice on how to trigger '$$ビッグオー$$ Final Stage' and watches the battle through to its outcome.

library.pt_240:r_c8a63848b1c38e46.text:
A fair-skinned man who works under $$ベック$$.
He is known for speaking with a flamboyant, effeminate manner.

library.pt_240:r_643b067d6e6d6a8a.text:
A stocky man who works under $$ベック$$.
Together with $$ダヴ$$, he broke $$ベック$$ out of prison.

library.pt_240:r_c1baead826d24ce4.text:
A mercenary belonging to the anti-terrorist organization $$ミスリル$$. His rank is sergeant, callsign Urzu 7.
He appears to be ethnically Japanese, and is physically marked by a cross-shaped scar on his left cheek.
Aboard the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ he is an $$ＳＲＴ$$ (Special Response Team) operative, and is often seen in action alongside fellow members $$マオ$$ and $$クルツ$$. He is skilled at piloting an AS and handling firearms, a combat professional with calm judgment and swift action. He is serious by nature, and as a soldier always makes it a point to be ready to respond to the unexpected.
Before joining $$ミスリル$$ he called himself 'Kashim' and fought as a guerrilla from the age of 8. He then spent his past drifting through conflict zones around the world as a mercenary. His $$ミスリル$$ superior $$カリーニン$$ is an acquaintance from that time, and the two have survived numerous brushes with death together.
He transfers into Jindai High School's Class 2-4 for the top-secret mission of guarding $$千鳥かなめ$$, but his unfamiliarity with student life combined with his overly dutiful nature toward his mission cause him to stir up all manner of trouble, making him a great nuisance to those around him as a troublemaker.
Even while leading a chaotic high school life, he fights off countless enemies and continues to protect $$かなめ$$.

library.pt_240:r_daeeb241da4c4210.text:
A mercenary belonging to the anti-terrorist organization $$ミスリル$$. His rank is sergeant, callsign Urzu 7.
He appears to be ethnically Japanese, and is physically marked by a cross-shaped scar on his left cheek.
Aboard the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ he is an $$ＳＲＴ$$ (Special Response Team) operative, and is often seen in action alongside fellow members $$マオ$$ and $$クルツ$$. He is skilled at piloting an AS and handling firearms, a combat professional with calm judgment and swift action. He is serious by nature, and as a soldier always makes it a point to be ready to respond to the unexpected.
Before joining $$ミスリル$$ he called himself 'Kashim' and fought as a guerrilla from the age of 8. He then spent his past drifting through conflict zones around the world as a mercenary. His $$ミスリル$$ superior $$カリーニン$$ is an acquaintance from that time, and the two have survived numerous brushes with death together.
He transfers into Jindai High School's Class 2-4 for the top-secret mission of guarding $$千鳥かなめ$$, but his unfamiliarity with student life combined with his overly dutiful nature toward his mission cause him to stir up all manner of trouble, making him a great nuisance to those around him as a troublemaker.
In the course of the fighting, he becomes the dedicated pilot of the Arbalest, the only Lambda Driver-equipped AS in $$ミスリル$$'s possession.
Considering the unstable Lambda Driver unreliable as a weapon, he feels an aversion toward the Arbalest and its onboard AI, $$アル$$, from the very start. During the operation in Hong Kong, a series of events pile up until he finally refuses to pilot it and fight, but after reuniting with $$かなめ$$ and casting off his doubts, he returns to piloting the Arbalest. In that battle, he also comes to acknowledge $$アル$$ as his 'partner.'
Even while leading a chaotic high school life, as he fights off countless enemies and continues to protect $$かなめ$$, he clumsily grows closer to her in heart, and the two come to see each other as irreplaceable.

library.pt_240:r_a6e21ee335987c69.text:
A mercenary belonging to the anti-terrorist organization $$ミスリル$$. Her rank is master sergeant, callsign Urzu 2.
She is an $$ＳＲＴ$$ (Special Response Team) operative aboard the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, and the superior officer of $$宗介$$ and $$クルツ$$. A former Marine, she is well versed in every kind of duty, from piloting an AS to hand-to-hand combat, infiltration, and operating communications equipment. She has plenty of nerve, and $$宗介$$ and the others place absolute trust in her.
She is known for her short hair and a lithe figure like that of a female leopard, and she loves beer more than anything.
She is on close personal terms with $$テッサ$$, captain of the Danaan, and in private $$テッサ$$ calls her Melissa.
She is dispatched to Japan along with $$宗介$$ and $$クルツ$$ on the mission to guard $$千鳥かなめ$$. From then on, she fights alongside $$宗介$$ against a variety of enemies.

library.pt_240:r_4d281d91f1c95bb2.text:
A mercenary belonging to the anti-terrorist organization $$ミスリル$$. His rank is sergeant, callsign Urzu 6.
He is an $$ＳＲＴ$$ (Special Response Team) operative aboard the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ and a top-class genius sniper. His marksmanship is such that he can shoot a coin from a kilometer away.
A handsome young man with blond hair and blue eyes, he has even worked as a fashion magazine model. However, he talks too much, and is a playboy who flirts with any woman he sees. He is constantly needling $$マオ$$ as well, though it is unclear how serious he really is.
Incidentally, he lived in Edogawa, Tokyo until he was 14, and speaks fluent Japanese.
He is dispatched to Japan along with $$宗介$$ and $$マオ$$ on the mission to guard $$千鳥かなめ$$. From then on, he fights alongside $$宗介$$ against a variety of enemies.

library.pt_240:r_c9b1bf0384b56130.text:
Captain of the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, belonging to the anti-terrorist organization $$ミスリル$$. Her rank is colonel.
Though the same age as $$宗介$$ and $$かなめ$$, she is captain of the Danaan and commander of $$ミスリル$$'s West Pacific fleet as well. She possesses a genius eye for tactics, calm judgment, and strength of will.
She is gentle and easygoing by nature, but in truth quite the sore loser. She is also extremely clumsy at physical activity.
She takes great pride in her duties and behaves resolutely as a commander in battle. Her subordinates, $$マデューカス$$ foremost among them, place absolute trust in her because of it.
She has a habit of touching the tip of her nose with the end of her braided hair when thinking or feeling stressed.
She orders $$宗介$$ and the others to guard $$千鳥かなめ$$, and from then on fights alongside her subordinates against a variety of enemies while wrestling with various conflicts.

library.pt_240:r_0bb2f02fbd11cfe9.text:
Captain of the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, belonging to the anti-terrorist organization $$ミスリル$$. Her rank is colonel.
Though the same age as $$宗介$$ and $$かなめ$$, she is captain of the Danaan and commander of $$ミスリル$$'s West Pacific fleet as well. She possesses a genius eye for tactics, calm judgment, and strength of will.
She is a '$$ウィスパード$$' who possesses knowledge of the unknown science known as 'Black Technology,' and it was she who designed the modifications for the Danaan.
She is gentle and easygoing by nature, but in truth quite the sore loser. She is also extremely clumsy at physical activity.
She takes great pride in her duties and behaves resolutely as a commander in battle. Her subordinates, $$マデューカス$$ foremost among them, place absolute trust in her because of it.
She has a habit of touching the tip of her nose with the end of her braided hair when thinking or feeling stressed.
She orders $$宗介$$ and the others to guard $$千鳥かなめ$$, and from then on fights alongside her subordinates against a variety of enemies while wrestling with various conflicts.
She takes an interest in $$宗介$$, who is the same age as her, and looks out for him in various ways, and this feeling gradually turns into romantic love. She declares her romantic rivalry to $$かなめ$$, who is close to $$宗介$$, but separately from that, becomes her friend.
Her parents are already deceased, but she has one older brother, whose whereabouts are currently unknown.

library.pt_240:r_507147048fbd9c94.text:
Executive officer of the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, belonging to the anti-terrorist organization $$ミスリル$$. His rank is lieutenant colonel.
His trademarks are a stern expression along with glasses and a hat.
A man of a military bearing who once served as the captain of a British Navy submarine, he values discipline above all else. He sometimes voices his opinions about the actions of Captain $$テッサ$$, but this is only because he wants her, whom he holds in high esteem, to always be a fine captain.
$$宗介$$ finds him intimidating, and is often seen visibly tense when facing him.
Through countless battles, he supports Captain $$テッサ$$ while protecting her at the risk of his own life.

library.pt_240:r_594863108af39005.text:
The $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$'s (TDD-1) central computer, Mother AI.
It controls every piece of equipment and machinery aboard the Danaan.
In the 'full auto mode' supported by $$ダーナ$$, the ship can be operated, in a limited fashion, even by a single person.

library.pt_240:r_f5940f1162d8b9da.text:
The $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$'s (TDD-1) central computer, Mother AI.
It controls every piece of equipment and machinery aboard the Danaan.
In the 'full auto mode' supported by $$ダーナ$$, the ship can be operated, in a limited fashion, even by a single person.
After the battle at Berylda Obu Island, $$ガウルン$$ - who infiltrates the Danaan disguised as a prisoner - seizes the command center and rewrites its programming. As a result, it comes to recognize $$ガウルン$$ as captain, but it is restored to its normal state thanks to the efforts of $$かなめ$$ and $$テッサ$$.

library.pt_240:r_924e46fa5014edba.text:
Belongs to the operations department of $$ミスリル$$'s West Pacific fleet, the anti-terrorist organization. His rank is major.
Aboard the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, he is the operations commander who acts as $$テッサ$$'s right hand, directing the ground forces. He is always calm and collected, and does not hesitate to make ruthless decisions when the mission demands it. Yet he is also a man of loyalty and deep feeling, and $$テッサ$$ and his subordinates place absolute trust in him.
He once served as a commanding officer in the special forces of a certain country, but was driven from his homeland after being caught up in a conspiracy, and was saved by guerrillas he had once fought as an enemy. He is an acquaintance of $$宗介$$ from that time, and the two have since survived countless brushes with death together.

library.pt_240:r_6cf65da7082e69d2.text:
A mercenary belonging to the anti-terrorist organization $$ミスリル$$. His rank is captain, callsign Urzu 1.
He is the top man among the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$'s $$ＳＲＴ$$ (Special Response Team) operatives, and is deeply trusted by his subordinates and comrades. He also has strong decision-making skills, and it was he who selected $$マオ$$ for the callsign Urzu 2.

library.pt_240:r_865a95809d9bbd73.text:
A mercenary belonging to the anti-terrorist organization $$ミスリル$$. His rank is captain, callsign Urzu 1.
He is the top man among the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$'s $$ＳＲＴ$$ (Special Response Team) operatives, and is deeply trusted by his subordinates and comrades. He also has strong decision-making skills, and it was he who selected $$マオ$$ for the callsign Urzu 2.
When he won a kiss from $$テッサ$$ at a bingo tournament held aboard ship, he beamed with unrestrained joy, but he later lost his life at the hands of a traitor and $$ガウルン$$.

library.pt_240:r_dcf8bbf3fa05f757.text:
A mercenary belonging to the anti-terrorist organization $$ミスリル$$. His rank is corporal, callsign Urzu 10.
He is an $$ＳＲＴ$$ (Special Response Team) operative who came from a certain country's army.

library.pt_240:r_acbfe27ad9354fd6.text:
A mercenary belonging to the anti-terrorist organization $$ミスリル$$. His rank is corporal, callsign Urzu 10.
He is an $$ＳＲＴ$$ (Special Response Team) operative who came from a certain country's army.
Together with $$ダニガン$$, he betrays $$ミスリル$$, freeing $$ガウルン$$ from where he was being held prisoner aboard the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, and falls under his command. He later pursues $$かなめ$$ as she heads for Lady Chapel, but is defeated by $$クルツ$$ and $$マオ$$.

library.pt_240:r_3e47eb134ebc17e8.text:
A mercenary belonging to the anti-terrorist organization $$ミスリル$$. His rank is sergeant, callsign Urzu 12.
He is an $$ＳＲＴ$$ (Special Response Team) operative who came from a certain country's airborne forces.

library.pt_240:r_7f5a01ab9c0331eb.text:
A mercenary belonging to the anti-terrorist organization $$ミスリル$$. His rank is sergeant, callsign Urzu 12.
He is an $$ＳＲＴ$$ (Special Response Team) operative who came from a certain country's airborne forces.
Together with $$グェン$$, he betrays $$ミスリル$$, freeing $$ガウルン$$ from where he was being held prisoner aboard the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, and falls under his command. He later pursues $$かなめ$$ as she heads for Lady Chapel, but is defeated by $$宗介$$.

library.pt_240:r_7d6b5f5ae67d0d6e.text:
Belongs to the assault mecha company at the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force's Nerima base. His rank is master sergeant.
He is the captain of the Nerima Red Dragon, the AS unit that is Nerima base's pride. His skill at piloting an AS is such that even $$宗介$$ acknowledges it, and Nerima has come out on top every year in its AS competition matches against Narashino base.
However, he has a highly narcissistic personality, and persistently hits on $$かなめ$$.
At the AS competition held during Narashino base's open festival, he invites $$かなめ$$ to join him in a mock cavalry battle. He deploys an unconventional formation attack that gives Narashino's assault mecha company a hard time.

library.pt_240:r_015f77137153d886.text:
Belongs to the assault mecha company at the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force's Nerima base. His rank is master sergeant.
He is the captain of the Nerima Red Dragon, the AS unit that is Nerima base's pride. His skill at piloting an AS is such that even $$宗介$$ acknowledges it, and Nerima has come out on top every year in its AS competition matches against Narashino base.
However, he has a highly narcissistic personality, and persistently hits on $$かなめ$$.
At the AS competition held during Narashino base's open festival, he invites $$かなめ$$ to join him in a mock cavalry battle. He deploys an unconventional formation attack that gives Narashino's assault mecha company a hard time, but in the end, thanks to the efforts of the $$風間$$ father and son, he is defeated by the Narashino team.

library.pt_240:r_17a4c2f12a4b8240.text:
An international terrorist whose real name and nationality are unknown.
His backers are also unknown, but his primary objective is the abduction of $$千鳥かなめ$$.
He is cold and brutal by nature, and takes pleasure in violence. At the same time, he is a calculating and highly capable soldier who always assesses the situation calmly.
He is also skilled at piloting an AS, and can handle even a Lambda Driver-equipped AS with ease.
He calls $$宗介$$ by his guerrilla-era name 'Kashim,' and shares a history with him as well as with $$カリーニン$$. He also has a large scar running from his forehead to his right cheek, which was given to him by $$宗介$$ back in his guerrilla days.

library.pt_240:r_01301c8385ee472f.text:
An international terrorist whose real name and nationality are unknown.
He is employed by the secret organization Amalgam, and with the abduction of $$千鳥かなめ$$ as his primary objective, he hijacks a jet carrying students from Jindai High School.
He is cold and brutal by nature, and takes pleasure in violence. At the same time, he is a calculating and highly capable soldier who always assesses the situation calmly.
He is also skilled at piloting an AS, and can handle even a Lambda Driver-equipped AS with ease.
He calls $$宗介$$ by his guerrilla-era name 'Kashim,' and shares a history with him as well as with $$カリーニン$$. He also has a large scar running from his forehead to his right cheek, which was given to him by $$宗介$$ back in his guerrilla days.
Even after the hijacking incident, he continues to stand in the way of $$ミスリル$$ and $$宗介$$, and in particular he denies the very way $$宗介$$ lives his life, dealing him great psychological damage. However, he suffers massive damage in the battle following his hijacking of the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, and in the end, from his deathbed, he provokes the wavering $$宗介$$ and self-destructs in an attempt to take him down with him.

library.pt_240:r_1f8f8b84d5026485.text:
A terrorist who works alongside $$ガウルン$$.
He fought together with $$宗介$$ in the same guerrilla group since childhood, spending his days as a friend, and taught him tactics.
As a boy he had a gentle nature, but by the time he is reunited with $$宗介$$, he has become cold and dismissive of anyone who dies for ideals or sentiment.
He pilots the $$Ｚｙ－９８　シャドウ$$, and wields a Gatling cannon.

library.pt_240:r_4bef176a150d6654.text:
A terrorist who works alongside $$ガウルン$$.
He fought together with $$宗介$$ in the same guerrilla group since childhood, spending his days as a friend, and taught him tactics.
As a boy he had a gentle nature, but by the time he is reunited with $$宗介$$, he has become cold and dismissive of anyone who dies for ideals or sentiment.
He pilots the $$Ｚｙ－９８　シャドウ$$, and wields a Gatling cannon.
He reunites with $$宗介$$ as an enemy in Helmajistan, where he spent his boyhood. Knowing $$宗介$$'s tactics intimately, he repeatedly outmaneuvers him and drives him into a corner, but in the end he is defeated by $$宗介$$'s desperate final blow.

library.pt_240:r_2cc8cdfee7cda4e6.text:
Leader of the terrorist group A21.
Out of loyalty and a desire for revenge for Seiji Takechi, whom she looked up to like a father, she plots a terrorist attack in Tokyo together with her former comrades.
She acts as a cold, calculating commander in pursuit of her goal, using $$タクマ$$ - who believes her to be his older sister - to pilot $$ベヘモス$$.
Yet in her conversation with the captive $$カリーニン$$, she also reveals a more human side.

library.pt_240:r_d89e5ad82473bf03.text:
Leader of the terrorist group A21.
Out of loyalty and a desire for revenge for Seiji Takechi, whom she looked up to like a father, she plots a terrorist attack in Tokyo together with her former comrades.
She acts as a cold, calculating commander in pursuit of her goal, using $$タクマ$$ - who believes her to be his older sister - to pilot $$ベヘモス$$.
Yet in her conversation with the captive $$カリーニン$$, she also reveals a more human side.
Though she succeeds in activating $$ベヘモス$$, she is wounded, and in the end is watched over in her final moments by her enemy, $$カリーニン$$.

library.pt_240:r_99a485600699cb52.text:
Pilot of $$ベヘモス$$.
He was a member of A21, a rehabilitation group for troubled boys and girls, but after its leader Seiji Takechi met an unfortunate death, he lost his sense of purpose, and as his answer, plans a terrorist attack in Tokyo.
Ordered by A21's commander, his older sister $$セイナ$$, he pilots the giant Lambda Driver-equipped AS, $$ベヘモス$$.

library.pt_240:r_9f951a2c8cfdd081.text:
Pilot of $$ベヘモス$$.
He was a member of A21, a rehabilitation group for troubled boys and girls, but after its leader Seiji Takechi met an unfortunate death, he lost his sense of purpose, and as his answer, plans a terrorist attack in Tokyo.
He looks up to A21's commander $$セイナ$$ as an older sister, but this is only $$タクマ$$'s own belief - the two are not actually related by blood. Even so, hoping to earn $$セイナ$$'s praise, $$タクマ$$ boards $$ベヘモス$$ and fights.
In the end, he faces off against $$宗介$$'s Arbalest. Defeated after $$ベヘモス$$'s Lambda Driver cooling system is shot through, he breathes his last in the arms of $$テッサ$$, with whom he had briefly shared a bond.

library.pt_240:r_bf7de9c18ac1adca.text:
A high school girl attending Jindai High School. Age 16.
She is the class representative of Class 2-4 and also serves as vice president of the student council. Blessed with outstanding athletic ability, she is called in as a last-minute reinforcement whenever matches for the various sports clubs draw near.
She has a straightforward personality with no hidden agenda, is caring, and full of energy. She holds the unwelcome title of 'Idol I'd least want as a girlfriend,' yet she is a popular figure trusted by boys and girls alike.
She finds herself swept up by the strange behavior of the transfer student $$宗介$$, and this encounter comes to greatly change the course of her fate.

library.pt_240:r_e4f01ea1a1cfe724.text:
A high school girl attending Jindai High School. Age 16.
She is the class representative of Class 2-4 and also serves as vice president of the student council. Blessed with outstanding athletic ability, she is called in as a last-minute reinforcement whenever matches for the various sports clubs draw near.
She has a straightforward personality with no hidden agenda, is caring, and full of energy. She holds the unwelcome title of 'Idol I'd least want as a girlfriend,' yet she is a popular figure trusted by boys and girls alike.
She finds herself swept up by the strange behavior of the transfer student $$宗介$$, and this encounter comes to greatly change the course of her fate.
Though she herself was unaware of it, she is one of the so-called '$$ウィスパード$$,' who possess knowledge of 'Black Technology,' a science that supposedly does not exist, and $$宗介$$ was an agent dispatched to guard her from organizations targeting that power. From then on, she and $$宗介$$ fight against a variety of enemies, $$ガウルン$$ chief among them, and in the process grow closer in heart.

library.pt_240:r_19ebed3a2f07b2ac.text:
A student in Jindai High School's Class 2-4.
He is lively by nature, and something of the class mood-maker.

library.pt_240:r_333e1afda784dbfb.text:
A student in Jindai High School's Class 2-4.
He is lively by nature, and something of the class mood-maker.
As a perfectly average high school boy, when the class went on a hot spring trip, he teamed up with $$クルツ$$ in a joint campaign to find the women's bath.

library.pt_240:r_93142f91dc00c4f1.text:
A student in Jindai High School's Class 2-4.
A military otaku whose hobby is photographing weapons such as ASs, he belongs to the photography club at school. His knowledge of military affairs is such that even $$宗介$$ is impressed.
He does not know $$宗介$$'s true identity, but considers him a kindred spirit due to his military knowledge, and the two get along well, often acting together.
His father, Shintarou, serves as a staff officer at the Self-Defense Force's Narashino base.

library.pt_240:r_26250116d7d42e9e.text:
A student in Jindai High School's Class 2-4.
She is $$かなめ$$'s classmate and close friend.
She belongs to the softball club, and often asks the athletically gifted $$かなめ$$ to fill in as backup. She also looks out for $$かなめ$$ in other ways, such as arranging dates for boys who have a crush on her.
She understands $$かなめ$$ better than anyone, and sometimes calls her out when $$かなめ$$ tries to hide her true feelings.

library.pt_240:r_9a20ab83b3a2fd7e.text:
A student in Jindai High School's Class 2-4.
A girl known for her short haircut, she is on good terms with $$かなめ$$ and $$恭子$$.

library.pt_240:r_9615160696d8cebd.text:
Homeroom teacher of Jindai High School's Class 2-4.
She has a strong sense of justice and a serious personality, and is constantly troubled by the commotion caused by the transfer student $$宗介$$.

library.pt_240:r_27f52efdd3f2482c.text:
The mascot character of the amusement park '$$ふもふもランド$$.'
An adorable character who speaks in words like 'fumoffu' and 'fumofumo,' it hands out balloons around the park and poses for photos with guests.

library.pt_240:r_031c78c86ddd5bc4.text:
The amusement park '$$ふもふもランド$$' mascot character... modified by $$宗介$$.
It is commonly thought of as a costume, but in truth it is more like a small-scale AS, equipped internally with a variety of devices.
As a distinguishing physical feature, it has the same cross-shaped scar on its left cheek as $$宗介$$.
It is also fitted with the voice changer function originally built into the costume, but for some reason, turning this off causes all of its functions to stop working. As a result, the function must always be kept on, and consequently, no matter what it says, the output to the outside always comes out sounding like some variation of 'fumoffu!' $$かなめ$$, however, is able to understand its meaning and interpret for it.
With agility unimaginable from its round build, and with firearms, it takes down villains one after another.

library.pt_240:r_608037b56a3bda87.text:
President of Jindai High School's student council.
He also serves as chairman of the Tama district high school self-governance liaison council, engaging in outside activities as well.
He is undeniably brilliant and unflappable, but a mysterious figure whose true intentions are hard to read. His trademarks, distinct from the other students, are a white stand-collar uniform and a folding fan.
Even when $$宗介$$ causes an uproar, such as blowing up the shoe lockers, he wields considerable political skill, saying things like 'I will have a word with the faculty myself,' and does not yield an inch to the faculty in the name of student self-governance.
Incidentally, he gets along well with $$宗介$$, and appoints him as his aide for security affairs, assistant to the student council president.
He often asks $$宗介$$ and student council vice president $$かなめ$$ to handle unusual errands.

library.pt_240:r_48292f8a0e222ac7.text:
Secretary of Jindai High School's student council.
She is always at the side of student council president $$林水$$, assisting him.
She has a gentle, easygoing personality, and is unfazed even by the commotion $$宗介$$ stirs up. Because of her air, $$かなめ$$ and the others call her '$$蓮$$-san.'

library.pt_240:r_0b72a7e3d438c6d5.text:
Secretary of Jindai High School's student council.
She is always at the side of student council president $$林水$$, assisting him, and secretly harbors feelings for him.
She has a gentle, easygoing personality, and is unfazed even by the commotion $$宗介$$ stirs up. Because of her air, $$かなめ$$ and the others call her '$$蓮$$-san.'
Incidentally, her family runs the Mikihara-gumi, a street-stall vendors' group.

library.pt_240:r_d9090f2144d34903.text:
Head of Jindai High School's karate club.
A practitioner of the Daidoumyaku style. He has a personality overflowing with a sense of justice, such as protecting $$かなめ$$ and the others from delinquents, but has a weakness for women.
He fights a serious duel with $$宗介$$ over the eviction of the club room.

library.pt_240:r_88a747b5e8c05d9b.text:
Head of Jindai High School's karate club.
A practitioner of the Daidoumyaku style. He has a personality overflowing with a sense of justice, such as protecting $$かなめ$$ and the others from delinquents, but has a weakness for women. He is also extremely nearsighted, and cannot make out a person even a few meters away without his glasses.
He fights a serious duel with $$宗介$$ over the eviction of the club room.
He has feelings for $$かなめ$$, and continues to rival $$宗介$$ over one thing or another afterward, engaging him in further contests.

library.pt_240:r_bfc8db822c3968ea.text:
Captain of Jindai High School's rugby club.
He has a gentle, peaceable personality, seen in the way he devotes himself to volunteer work, spends time in a clubroom with a girlish decor, and runs pastoral passing drills.
With the rugby club in danger of being disbanded, he takes in $$宗介$$ and $$かなめ$$ as a substitute player and manager respectively, on $$林水$$'s instructions.

library.pt_240:r_7d456be01d9df35e.text:
Captain of Jindai High School's rugby club.
He has a gentle, peaceable personality, seen in the way he devotes himself to volunteer work, spends time in a clubroom with a girlish decor, and runs pastoral passing drills.
With the rugby club in danger of being disbanded, he takes in $$宗介$$ and $$かなめ$$ as a substitute player and manager respectively, on $$林水$$'s instructions. To prepare for the match against Garasuyama High School, he undergoes $$宗介$$'s brutal Marine-style training regimen and is reborn as a killing machine.

library.pt_240:r_21cfab52304c9d98.text:
A member of Jindai High School's rugby club.
With the rugby club in danger of being disbanded, he joins captain $$郷田$$ and the others in taking in $$宗介$$ and $$かなめ$$ as a substitute player and manager.

To prepare for the match against Garasuyama High School, he undergoes $$宗介$$'s brutal Marine-style training regimen and is reborn as a killing machine.

library.pt_240:r_b72daed1665b3291.text:
A member of Jindai High School's karate club.
He is active in pursuit of an ultra-practical mixed martial art.
Incidentally, that name is not his real one - $$かなめ$$ simply started calling him that on her own.

library.pt_240:r_7da4c07e27d3ea77.text:
A member of Jindai High School's karate club.
He is active in pursuit of an ultra-practical mixed martial art.
Incidentally, that name is not his real one - $$かなめ$$ simply started calling him that on her own.
When $$宗介$$ and the others come to serve notice of the clubroom's eviction, he flatly opposes it and challenges them to a fight. But he is defeated after $$宗介$$ hits him with a gas attack, writhing in agony.
